args.content:
# Pinout

| Header | Net | U1 pin | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| J1.1 | 3V3 | DVDD 13, 14; DEVDD 15; EVDD 28 | External 3.3 V rail. |
| J1.2 | GND | AVSS/DVSS/EPAD | Common return. |
| J1.3 | MOSI | 22 | Host-to-radio SPI data. |
| J1.4 | MISO | 20 | Radio-to-host SPI data. |
| J1.5 | SCLK | 19 | SPI clock. |
| J1.6 | SEL | 23 | Active-low SPI select. |
| J1.7 | IRQ | 24 | Radio interrupt. |
| J1.8 | RESET | 8 | Active-low reset with 100 kOhm pull-up. |
| J1.9 | SLP_TR | 11 | Radio sleep/transmit control. |

AVDD is filtered from 3V3 by FB1. RF_P and RF_N use L1/L2 and C9/C10; RF_FEED reaches AE1 and TP5. U1 DIG1-DIG4 and CLKM are intentionally unconnected.
